title: Preserve evidence timestamps from item attachments
description:
Purpose: Make score timestamp enrichment reliable when transcript artifacts are attached to an Item rather than embedded in metadata.

Definition of Done:
- Behavior is specified with an executable test.
- Timestamp enrichment can load a Deepgram attachment using the Item's recorded attachment key.
- Existing metadata-based enrichment behavior remains supported.
- Focused tests pass.
